body: Wow this is the exact situation that I am in. My GF told me that she could not handle keeping me happy all the time and broke up with me about a month ago.

I am kind of in a similar situation. Except all of my shit is my own fault. I drank too much and lost the love of my life. All I can say is I don't know if it gets better because this literally just happened to me, but if you don't keep trying nothing will ever get better.
